# Spar 0.6.12

This release adds spaced review. When a solve is accepted, Spar files what
cracked it as an insight card and schedules it with FSRS, the scheduler Anki
uses. Due cards come back as a short review session: Spar writes a fresh prompt
from the insight, grades your answer, and reschedules the card from how it went.
A reminder appears when something is due, and cards you keep forgetting are
shown to the agent as gaps rather than solved topics.

Also in this release:

- Challenge statements can carry figures. Trees, linked lists, graphs, grids and
  arrays are drawn from the same values as the example beside them, so the
  picture and the example cannot disagree.
- Skills: specialised agent instructions that load only when a turn needs them,
  starting with the figure spec. Settings lists them and lets you turn each one
  off.
- The workspace toolbar is rebuilt: a language menu, run controls that choose
  between local examples and the source's own judge, and challenge actions in
  one place.
- Editor settings: pick a code font (Geist Mono, SF Mono, Fira Code and others) and turn
  IntelliSense on or off. It stays off by default, because a completion popup
  finishing the line is the thing being practised.
- Each session chooses its problem sources (Spar, LeetCode, Codeforces) from one
  control.
- Every challenge gets its own gem.
- The misconception check for Python challenges is settled by running the code
  rather than by another model round.
- Search, statements, attempt reports and result panels received a round of
  fixes.
